modmenu.descriptionTranslation.smoothhot: Smooth hotbar with a sliding selection, easing curves, a portal between slots 1 and 9 and smooth cooldowns.
smoothhotbar.config.title: Smooth Hotbar - Settings
smoothhotbar.option.enabled.tooltip: Turn off to get the untouched vanilla hotbar back without removing the mod.
smoothhotbar.option.design.tooltip: Vanilla keeps the game's hotbar textures, so resource packs apply. Custom draws a flat panel configured on the Custom design tab. Animations work in both.
smoothhotbar.option.bottom_offset.toolti: How far the hotbar floats above the bottom of the screen, in GUI pixels. Hearts, hunger and experience move with it.
smoothhotbar.option.scale.tooltip: Size of the hotbar together with the status bars above it.
smoothhotbar.option.background_opacity.t: 0 hides the panel completely and leaves only the items.
smoothhotbar.option.slot_backgrounds.too: Draw a faint cell behind every slot.
smoothhotbar.option.accent_color.tooltip: Color of the selection frame, slot cells and attack indicator.
smoothhotbar.option.easing.tooltip: Curve of the selection animation. Overshoot and Elastic go slightly past the slot and settle back.
smoothhotbar.option.selection_ms.tooltip: Time for the selection frame to reach the new slot.
smoothhotbar.option.selected_scale.toolt: How much the item in the selected slot grows. 100 turns the effect off.
smoothhotbar.option.wrap_portal.tooltip: Going from slot 9 to 1 or back, the frame leaves through one edge and enters from the other instead of flying across the whole hotbar.
smoothhotbar.option.smooth_cooldowns.too: Item cooldowns such as ender pearls shrink every frame instead of in pixel steps.
smoothhotbar.option.auto_hide.tooltip: Slide the hotbar off the screen while you are not using it. It comes back when you switch slots, pick up or use items, take damage or open a screen.
smoothhotbar.option.hide_delay.tooltip: Idle time before the hotbar hides.
smoothhotbar.option.hide_anim_ms.tooltip: Duration of the slide in and out.
smoothhotbar.option.hide_whole_hud.toolt: Hearts, hunger, armor and experience hide together with the hotbar. Turn off to hide only the hotbar.
smoothhotbar.option.show_on_damage.toolt: Bring the hotbar back when you lose health.
smoothhotbar.option.show_on_use.tooltip: Keep the hotbar visible while you attack, eat, block or draw a bow.
